categories_thin: Title agencies and escrow: none located inside Middlesex Borough; the registered title companies found were in Piscataway and New Brunswick.
Staffing: only two found, both single-directory listings.
Property management and real estate brokerages: still thin (Emess, Forte and a few small brokerages); most 08846 agents appear to hang their licence at offices in Bound Brook, Piscataway or Dunellen.
Veterinarians and optometrists: one and two respectively, which looks genuine for a 3.5 sq mi borough.
Group D (retail, childcare, education, manufacturing, logistics): not swept, because the brief covers groups AB plus the trades and auto lines the checker asked to add.
caveats: Group scope: the brief says groups AB, but the checker found the trades and auto repair almost entirely missing and asked for them. Group C (trades, home and auto) businesses are therefore included and labelled group C; drop that block if the client wants A/B only.

Excluded as branded/franchise or brand-affiliated after verification: Allison Roy - State Farm (branded carrier agent), David Basile - Allstate (branded carrier agent, single aggregator source), O'Donnell Agency (Nationwide agency whose own site lists Cranford and Raritan only), Evenly Orthodontics (multi-site NJ brand), Honest-1 Auto Care (683 Bound Brook Rd, national franchise), PuroClean Disaster Response (franchise), Simon Roofing Company (national commercial roofing firm), Rota-Rooter Plumbing.

Removed after verification: Curcio Louis J (occupation unconfirmed, single stub), C G Bookkeeping Services (no address, single stub), MedStop NJ (one directory listing only, category not confirmed), Healing Art of Acupuncture (own contact page now lists a Somerset office).
Birdeye's Contractors list includes several records with Australian-style addresses and postcode 3116 (Pty Ltd firms, 'Eustace Cl', 'Springsong Pass'); those were treated as data errors and excluded.

Many trades and auto entries rest on a single directory page with an address and review count; they are marked 'one directory only' or 'map/directory listing with reviews' and need confirmation before outreach.
Several contractor addresses published in directories are on residential streets and are probably home-based offices; they are recorded only as the business's own published listing address.

Shared office suites (495 Union Ave, 147 Union Ave, 141 Union Ave, 601 Bound Brook Rd, 1273 Bound Brook Rd, 200 South Ave) are typical of the borough and probably house more firms than any directory lists.
Middlesex Family Dental appears with two different phone numbers across directories (own website: 732-926-1234).
Some address strings are exactly as the directory published them (including '27 Hamiltonian Apartments', '124 Hamiltonian Apartments' and '398 County Rd 607') and were not corrected.
data_gaps: YellowPages, SuperPages, Manta, Justia, BBB category pages, Cylex, Booksy list pages and some insurer PDFs returned 403 or JS-only content to direct fetches; where their data is used it came from search-engine result summaries rather than an opened page.

Phones are recorded as Unknown for many Birdeye-only trades and auto entries because the listing pages did not expose phone numbers in the extracted text; the triage team should pull them from the listing or the business site.
Google Maps / Bing Maps were not swept as a map layer; a map pass along Union Ave and Bound Brook Rd would likely surface several more small offices and home-based contractors.
Solo mental-health practitioners listed individually on Psychology Today for 08846 (roughly 15-20 profiles) were not enumerated, to avoid publishing what may be individuals' home offices.
No official Borough of Middlesex business directory or licensed-business list was found; the borough website's community directory is described as under construction.

Removed but unresolved: MedStop NJ (138 Bound Brook Rd) and Curcio Louis J (495 Union Ave) are probably real local entities but had one thin listing each and no confirmable category, so they are out of the list pending a phone check.
Erica Mandell's Middlesex office could not be confirmed from her own site (no address published); Martindale lists New Brunswick.
